text: {"lessons":["I should avoid repeatedly trimming winners just to lock in gains; I need a clear target allocation and should let positions participate when the outlook remains sound.","Frequent, broad buying can concentrate risk and use cash inefficiently; I should evaluate each stock and the portfolio together before trading.","A few months of gains do not prove my decisions are sound; I should judge results over time against my plan and rebalance only when risk or fundamentals warrant it."]}
